title: Waterbomb Base
description: The inverse of the preliminary base: book folds are valleys and the diagonals are mountains. It collapses into a triangle.

steps.title: Fold in half, bottom edge to top edge
steps.text: Fold in half, bottom edge to top edge. Valley fold (toward you), then unfold.

steps.title: Fold in half, left edge to right edge
steps.text: Fold in half, left edge to right edge. Valley fold (toward you), then unfold.

steps.title: Fold corner to opposite corner: bring the bottom-right corner to the top-left corner
steps.text: Fold corner to opposite corner: bring the bottom-right corner to the top-left corner. Mountain fold (away from you), then unfold.

steps.title: Fold corner to opposite corner: bring the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner
steps.text: Fold corner to opposite corner: bring the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner. Mountain fold (away from you), then unfold.

steps.title: Collapse along the existing creases
steps.text: Collapse along the existing creases: re-fold every valley toward you and every mountain away from you at the same time, then flatten.
